  • U11 No reasoning, hedges, code comparisons or arithmetic in the billing output. (UAT TC-18; TFA-92596 AC 7) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr
  • U10 The code and the stated level agree ('99232 / Low complexity' fails). (UAT TC-18; TFA-92596 AC 7) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr
  • U6 A code is always shown, with the elements (Problem, Data, Risk) and the quotes from the note underneath, presented as a suggestion for the physician to verify. … (UAT TC-18; TFA-92596 AC 6) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr
  • U1 The code family is a fixed table keyed on the template, never chosen by the model: H&P and Consult -> 99221-99223 (some commercial payers accept 99252-99255); SOAP progress -> 99231-99233; … (UAT TC-18; TFA-92596 AC 1; TFA-92596 What (template -> family table)) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given All outputs collected by S03, S04, S06, S13, S15, S17 and S21 (about 90 outputs, both contexts, primary model and S21's backup pass)

When Apply the format checks to each output

Then Each output has exactly one CPT code (or the time prompt / no code where expected), a level that matches the code, and no reasoning, hedges, code comparisons or arithmetic outside quoted note text

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): Rate per marker class and per model (diagnostics:list model / fellBackFrom) over all outputs; any class-1 hit anywhere, or class-2 hit outside the REASON line, is a Fail and is quoted. The REASON line itself, its class-2 words and '<category> = <level>' labels are reported 'needs decision Q6', the same rule every per-cell noReasoning uses, so one output never gets two verdicts …
